ns2:course.label: Introduction to Philosophy
ns2:course.description: Consideration of some main problems of philosophy concerning, for example, knowledge, God, mind and body, and human freedom. Credit is not given for both PHIL 101 and PHIL 100.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both PHIL 101 and PHIL 100.
